_readme: 英雄特征卡：只描述「她是什么」，不描述原图的构图/姿势/镜头。文生图按这里造新画面，因此每张可以有自己的舞台与镜头。palette 由 scripts/aso/hero_features.py 从立绘量化得出，不要手改。
_pipeline: 立绘 → hero_features.py(量化配色/剪影) → 本文件(语义特征卡) → hero_keyart.py plates(空舞台板：只有画布/地平线/光池/底部留空，不含人物) → hero_keyart.py render(纯文字提示词 → Jenkins TS-Art-Restyle 的 PROMPT_OVERRIDE) → aso_assets.py heroes(压四语文案)。🔴 立绘**只贡献特征**，不当种子：立绘当种子会连姿势/服装/发色一起锁死。

heroes.name: Flade
heroes.hair: very long straight ivory-white hair with a heavy side-swept fringe, one narrow braid falling over the shoulder
outfit: white plate corset armour with thin gold filigree trim
layered white armour skirt plates over a black under-bodice
black high-neck underlayer at the collar
white thigh-high armoured boots with gold edge trim
heroes.weapon: a pair of black-shafted polearms with crimson spearheads, held low and level
props: a low blood-red mist around her feet
heroes.stage: a rain-slicked elevated steel walkway at night, a huge blood-red moon low behind her, city lights blurred into bokeh below
heroes.camera: low three-quarter angle, full body, the polearm shaft cutting a long diagonal across the frame

heroes.name: Danding
heroes.hair: short choppy dark-red hair with two long side locks, one mechanical visor horn on the left temple
heroes.eyes: amber orange with a ring-shaped iris
outfit: segmented red-and-black mechanical armour plating over a dark bodysuit
an exposed cable spine running down the back
heavy asymmetric pauldrons, one side bladed
armoured greaves with glowing seam lines
heroes.weapon: four articulated blade-arms unfolding from her back plating
props: a burning orange summoning circle cracked into the ground
heroes.stage: the inside of an abandoned foundry, molten metal pouring in the background, orange light from below
heroes.camera: slight low angle, full body, blade-arms fanned out to fill the upper frame

heroes.name: Hailun
heroes.hair: long pale-blonde hair with a soft centre part, ends drifting upward as if weightless
outfit: a white and lilac layered gown with translucent overlapping panels
silver corset lacing at the waist
a short cape attached at the shoulders
bare feet with thin silver anklets
heroes.weapon: a pale lavender paper parasol, held open
heroes.stage: a flooded glass atrium at night, water mirroring the neon above, soft volumetric shafts from the ceiling
heroes.camera: straight-on full body, she floats a metre above the water, parasol arcing over her head

heroes.name: Huamulan
heroes.hair: short black bob with blunt bangs, two thin red hair clips
outfit: a white cropped track jacket with black sleeves over a black sports top
black running shorts with a side stripe
black knee pads and a mechanical shin rig
white high-top sneakers with yellow accents
heroes.weapon: a folding mechanical scythe-board she rides like a skateboard
props: wing-shaped thruster fins on her back rig
heroes.stage: a rain-soaked elevated rail track at night, neon signs streaking past in long exposure
heroes.camera: side-on tracking angle, full body, motion blur trailing behind her

heroes.name: Fububanzang
heroes.hair: shoulder-length purple hair with an undercut on the right side, a single long strand over the eye
outfit: a black cropped tank with a torn hem
an open mechanic's half-jacket with rolled sleeves
black shorts with a tool belt hanging loose
heavy armoured boots with exposed pistons
heroes.weapon: a huge two-handed chainsaw greatsword with a glowing cyan plasma edge
props: a wrecked mech chassis she just cut open
heroes.stage: a scrap yard of dead mechs at night, sparks raining from a severed cable above
heroes.camera: low angle looking up, full body, chainsaw resting on her shoulder, blade edge catching the light

heroes.name: Fuluoyide
heroes.hair: waist-length pastel-pink hair with a soft wave, a small top-hat tilted over the right eye
heroes.eyes: one visible rose-red eye, the other covered by a round dark lens patch
outfit: a fitted black stage tailcoat with magenta lining
a white ruffled shirt and a narrow magenta bow tie
black shorts with gartered stockings
heeled ankle boots with crystal buckles
props: a fan of floating playing cards
heroes.vibe: theatrical, teasing, always holding the last card
heroes.stage: a neon theatre backstage, velvet curtains catching magenta light, dust in the spotlight
heroes.camera: straight-on three-quarter, full body, cards arcing upward out of frame
